## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

The *Fóshuō Shùtíjiā jīng* (T540a) is the "a" recension of the *Jyotiṣka* sūtra, translated by Guṇabhadra 求那跋陀羅 ([求那跋陀羅](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B1%82%E9%82%A3%E8%B7%8B%E9%99%80%E7%BE%85)). *Shùtíjiā* 樹提伽 is a phonetic transliteration of *Jyotiṣka* — a wealthy lay Buddhist disciple. See [KR6i0171](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0171) (T540b) for the parallel "b" recension.

**Abstract**

A short *avadāna* narrative on the wealthy lay disciple Jyotiṣka. Translation dated to Guṇabhadra's productive period (435–468 CE).
